 News oi-Pooja Jaiswar By Pooja Jaiswar 
 Updated: Saturday, October 24, 2026, 18:54 [IST]
 Add as a preferred source on Google The Nagaland state is declaring its massive lottery called "PUJA Bumper" on October 24, 2026. The live draw of the Sambad Puja bumper lottery began at 6:00 PM on Saturday. The first prize winner will get a whopping Rs 3 crore, followed by Rs 10 lakh second prize and an Rs 5 lakh as third prize. In total, there are seven prizes under Puja bumper lottery, starting from Rs 1,000 to the highest of Rs 3 crore. The cost of the ticket is Rs 500.
 Nagaland Puja Bumper Lottery Result Today 24.10.2026 Live At 6PM; Rs 3 Crore First Prize, Full Prize Structure
 The first prize winner will get Rs 3 crore, while the second and third prize winner will get Rs 10 lakh and Rs 5 lakh. Meanwhile, the fourth prize winners will get Rs 9,000, 5th prize will get Rs 5,000, and the sixth prize winners will get Rs 3,000. The last and seventh prize winners will get Rs 1,000.

 How To Claim Nagaland Dear Puja Bumper Lottery Results Prizes?
 You can claim your lottery prizes at designated lottery shops in Nagaland if the winning amount is less than Rs 10,000. For prizes above Rs 10,000, you will be required to submit a claim form to the Director, Nagaland, State Lotteries/Nodal Officer.
 The Name of the claimant, Postal Address, Contact Number, Details of the Winning Ticket should be visibly clear along with Pan Card, Aadhar Card, Details of the Bank along with a cancelled cheque shall be enclosed with the Application form.
 As per the guidelines, the Original ticket shall be enclosed with 3 passport size photos & photocopy of the documents duly attested by a First-Class Magistrate/ Notary Public along with an affidavit swearing the ownership of the winning ticket.
 How Much Time It Takes For Nagaland Lottery Prizes To Get Credit?
 According to the government's guidelines, the Director shall disburse the Prize Money after proper verification of genuineness of the Lottery Ticket(s) and deduction of all taxes liable.
 There is 30% tax rate along with 4% cess imposed on any lottery winning amount. Hence, the prize will face similar taxes.
 The Prize money shall only be paid in the form of RTGS/ Demand Draft etc., after deducting the necessary commission/ charges as applicable.
 Last but not the least, all claims shall be submitted with complete application form and supporting documents to the Directorate/ Nodal Officer within 30 days from the date of draw published in its official gazattee for further process.
